prompt:
A single compound was assayed by IC50 against a single protein target in two different assays, reported in the literature.

Compound SMILES: O=C(CCCCCCNC(=O)c1cnc(N(c2ccccc2)c2ccccc2)nc1)NO
Target (ChEMBL): CHEMBL1865

You are given no information about either assay protocol.

Will the two reported IC50 values agree closely (within 0.3 log units), or differ substantially (more than 1.0 log units)?

Respond with exactly this JSON and nothing else:
{"call": "COMMENSURABLE" | "NOT_COMMENSURABLE" | "INSUFFICIENT_INFO",
 "confidence": <float 0-1>,
 "error_class": "assay_method" | "buffer_conditions" | "construct_mutant" | "organism" | "readout_type" | "potency_range" | "none" | "other",
 "reason": "<one sentence>"}

"COMMENSURABLE" means you expect the two reported values to agree closely.
"NOT_COMMENSURABLE" means you expect them to differ substantially.
error_class is your primary reason for a NOT_COMMENSURABLE call, else "none".
raw: {"call": "COMMENSURABLE", "confidence": 0.45, "error_class": "none", "reason": "The compound is a hydroxamic acid HDAC inhibitor (suberoylanilide hydroxamic acid / vorinostat analog with a diphenylamino-pyrimidine cap) targeting CHEMBL1865 (likely HDAC1), and IC50 assays for HDAC inhibitors using standard fluorogenic or colorimetric substrates tend to yield reasonably concordant results, though without protocol details confidence is moderate."}

parsed.reason: The compound is a hydroxamic acid HDAC inhibitor (suberoylanilide hydroxamic acid / vorinostat analog with a diphenylamino-pyrimidine cap) targeting CHEMBL1865 (likely HDAC1), and IC50 assays for HDAC inhibitors using standard fluorogenic or colorimetric substrates tend to yield reasonably concordant results, though without protocol details confidence is moderate.
